mapper.select: SELECT l.log_id, l.business_name, l.log_type, l.dept_id, d.dept_name AS dept_name, l.oper_id, u.nickname AS oper_name, u.username AS username, l.request_url, l.request_params, l.execution_time, l.status, l.error_msg, l.ip, l.address, l.browser, l.track_id, l.oper_time FROM sys_log l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = l.oper_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = l.dept_id WHERE l.log_id = #{logId}
